text: {"1208":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle defines the compiler's interned type representation and type context."},"1209":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"The tcx common-type fields are part of rustc_middle's type-context data structures."},"1210":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle implements type interning and the resulting efficient identity equality behavior."},"1211":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"The distinct representations of compiler types, including inference-variable forms, are defined by rustc_middle's type system."},"1212":{"about":["rustc_middle","rustc_infer"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle defines these type forms, while rustc_infer implements compatibility and equality-like inference operations between them."}}
